title: PyTorch C++ ATen strided tensor slice aliasing causing memory corruption in inplace autograd
problem_statement:
### Issue FRONTIER-GH-0125: PyTorch C++ ATen strided tensor slice aliasing causing memory corruption in inplace autograd
Repository: `pytorch/pytorch`
Category: `Memory Safety & Undefined Behavior`
Target File: `aten/src/ATen/native/TensorShape.cpp`

#### Problem Description
Inplace operation on non-contiguous strided tensor bypasses view mutation check when strides overlap.
Under high-load production execution, this defect triggers silent data corruption, deadlock, or assertion failure.

#### Concurrency & Invariant Conditions
- Precondition: Invariant validation must be enforced on physical silicon.
- Failure Mode: Reproduction fails with exit code != 0 or thread hang.
- Expected Fix Invariant: Enforce is_non_overlapping_and_dense validation before allowing in-place buffer mutation.

#### Reproduction Target
Run: `pytest tests/test_frontier-gh-0125.py -q`
expected_invariant: Enforce is_non_overlapping_and_dense validation before allowing in-place buffer mutation.
